pins.head: PICK THE VINYL BY THE SURFACE
pins.title: Permanent or Removable Vinyl: Decide by Where the Decal Will Live
pins.desc: The question is not which vinyl is better but where the decal is going. Mugs, tumblers and anything that gets washed or sits outdoors want permanent. Walls, laptops and seasonal decor want removable, so it peels off later without taking paint with it. Contains affiliate links. #CricutCrafts #AdhesiveVinyl #VinylDecals
pins.alt: A roll of coral vinyl and a roll of cream backing paper lying side by side on a pale wooden table.

pins.head: FABRIC BINS HIDE THE MESS
pins.sub: Organize a Small Apartment on a Budget
pins.title: Small Apartment Storage: Fabric Bins Turn Open Shelves Into Closed Ones
pins.desc: Open cubes look tidy for about a week. Fabric bins in two or three colors close them up, so the mixed small things behind them stop showing, and a bin pulls out whole when you need what is inside. Keep the top cube open for the things you use every day. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #CubeStorage #BudgetOrganizing
pins.alt: A white cube shelf with rust and teal fabric bins and a row of books, a caddy and a lamp on top, beside a window with potted plants in a small apartment.

pins.head: ONE SPARE SHELF IS ENOUGH
pins.title: Paper Goods Storage: Keep One Shelf of Spares and a Reorder Note
pins.desc: Paper rolls take up more space than anything else in a linen cupboard. Give the spares one shelf, clip a small note to its edge, and reorder when the shelf is half empty rather than when the last roll comes out. You stop buying in a panic and stop overbuying in a sale. Contains affiliate links. #HouseholdEssentials #LinenCloset #PantryPlanning
pins.alt: Stacks of white paper rolls on an upper shelf with a small clipped note on its edge, and folded white towels on the shelf below.

pins.head: HOOKS ABOVE, BASKETS BELOW
pins.title: Small Entryway for Renters: Hooks Above, a Bench and Baskets Below
pins.desc: A narrow entry only needs three things: hooks at coat height, a low bench to sit on while you take your shoes off, and baskets under it for the shoes themselves. Everything that comes in the door stops there instead of travelling into the rest of the room. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayIdeas #RenterFriendly #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: Coats hanging above a low wooden bench with a potted plant and a pair of shoes on it, two woven baskets underneath and a patterned rug on the floor.

pins.head: START WITH ROUND COASTERS
pins.sub: Epoxy Resin Kit With Coaster Molds
pins.title: Beginner Epoxy Resin Kit With Coaster Molds and Mixing Supplies
pins.desc: Round coaster molds are the easiest first resin project: a flat shape, an easy pour and a clean edge when it comes out. A starter kit with the resin, the molds and the mixing supplies in one box means the first pour does not wait on a second order. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #ResinCoasters #BeginnerCrafts
pins.alt: A hand lifting an amber resin coaster from a white silicone mold over a dark mat, with two more amber coasters on the mat by a sunny window.

pins.head: SHOES IN BOXES YOU CAN SEE
pins.title: Tiny Closet Organizing: Clear Shoe Boxes Make the Floor Usable
pins.desc: Shoes piled on a closet floor are the first thing to make a small closet feel full. Clear stacking boxes give each pair a shelf of its own, you can see which pair is which without opening anything, and the stack takes a fraction of the floor. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #ShoeStorage #SmallCloset
pins.alt: A small closet with clothes on a rail, a hanging shelf of folded sweaters and clear stacked shoe boxes on the floor below.

pins.head: CORKS KEEP FINGERS OFF
pins.title: Painting Miniatures: Mount Each Figure on a Cork Before You Start
pins.desc: Holding a miniature by its base rubs paint off the edges you just finished. Glue each figure to a wine cork first and hold the cork instead, so your fingers never touch the model and it stands up on its own while it dries. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #HobbyPainting #PaintingTips
pins.alt: Three grey miniature figures mounted on corks on a dark cutting mat, with fine brushes and a small jar beside them on a wooden table.

pins.head: FILL THE BOTTLES FROM THE POUCH
pins.title: Shampoo and Body Wash Refills: Keep the Pump Bottles and Buy Pouches
pins.desc: The pump bottle is the part you do not need to buy again. Keep two that you like, refill them from a large pouch, and the pouch costs less per ounce than a new bottle while taking up less room on the shelf. Contains affiliate links. #RefillRoutine #BathroomEssentials #SkincareBudget
pins.alt: Two pump bottles and a white refill pouch on a white bathroom counter by a window.

pins.head: MEASURE CUPS, NOT GUESSES
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Kit Size: Work Out the Volume Before You Buy
pins.desc: A kit that runs out halfway through a pour ruins the piece. Measure the mold in water first, pour that into a marked cup, and note the volume. Then buy a kit with comfortably more than that, since some resin always stays on the cup and the stick. Contains affiliate links. #ResinCrafts #EpoxyResin #CraftPlanning
pins.alt: Two bottles of epoxy resin, one clear and one amber, beside clear measuring cups and a notepad with a pencil on a wooden table.

pins.head: TAPE THE GAP BESIDE THE PIPES
pins.title: Under-Sink Organizer Sizes: Measure the Space Beside the Pipes
pins.desc: The cabinet width on the box means little when a drain pipe runs through the middle. Measure the clear space beside the pipes, both width and height, and pick a shelf that fits that gap. A tape measure along the cabinet floor takes a minute and saves a return. Contains affiliate links. #UnderSinkStorage #KitchenOrganization #MeasureFirst
pins.alt: An open under-sink cabinet with white drain pipes, a yellow tape measure stretched across the floor and a two-tier sage shelf beside the pipes.

pins.head: PODS SKIP THE MEASURING
pins.title: Free and Gentle Laundry Detergent Pods, 76 Count
pins.desc: Pods take the measuring out of laundry: one goes in the drum for a normal load and nothing drips down the side of a bottle. A free and gentle formula has no added dyes or perfumes, and a jar on the shelf shows how many are left. Contains affiliate links. #LaundryRoutine #LaundryPods #HouseholdEssentials
pins.alt: A glass jar of laundry pods beside a small kraft box and a white detergent jug, with folded towels on a shelf behind.

pins.head: A DRAWER THAT SHOWS THE COUNT
pins.title: Snack and Electrolyte Refills: A Divided Drawer Shows When to Reorder
pins.desc: Loose packets in a cupboard only get noticed when they run out. Clear dividers in one drawer keep stick packs standing in a row and bars laid flat, so a glance tells you how many are left, and the reorder happens before the last one goes. Contains affiliate links. #SnackDrawer #PantryOrganization #HydrationTips
pins.alt: An open wooden drawer with clear dividers holding upright white stick packs and wrapped bars.
